name: IPA Tasting Flight Experience
brief_description: Explore the world of IPAs with our guided tasting flight featuring 5 unique brews.
content:
IPA Tasting Flight Experience

Dive deep into the world of India Pale Ales with our expert-led tasting experience! Join Head Brewer Sarah for an educational and delicious journey through five carefully selected IPAs, each showcasing different hop profiles and brewing techniques.

What's Included

  • 5 beer samples (4 oz each) featuring different IPA styles
  • Tasting notes and flavor profile cards for each beer
  • Expert guidance from our Head Brewer Sarah
  • Food pairings - small bites designed to complement each beer
  • Take-home materials including hop variety guides and brewing tips

Featured IPAs

This month's flight explores the spectrum of hop flavors:

  1. West Coast IPA - Citrus and pine forward
  2. New England IPA - Tropical and juicy
  3. Session IPA - Light and approachable
  4. Double IPA - Bold and intense
  5. Specialty IPA - Unique seasonal variant

Educational Components

  • Hop varieties and their flavor contributions
  • Brewing techniques that affect IPA character
  • Proper tasting methods to identify flavors and aromas
  • Food pairing principles for hoppy beers
  • Home brewing tips for IPA enthusiasts

Who Should Attend

Perfect for:

  • Beer enthusiasts wanting to expand their palate
  • Home brewers looking to understand IPA styles
  • Anyone curious about the craft behind hoppy beers
  • Date night with a educational twist
  • Groups celebrating special occasions

Booking Information

  • Price: $25 per person
  • Duration: 2 hours
  • Group size: Limited to 25 participants for intimate experience
  • Age requirement: 21+ only
  • Advance booking required - call (555) 123-4567 or reserve online

Reserve your spot today for this popular monthly event!

name: Live Music Saturday - The Brew Notes
brief_description: Enjoy live acoustic performances from local artists while sipping our craft beers.
content:
Live Music Saturday: The Brew Notes

Get ready for an unforgettable evening of live music at Broken Loop Brewing! This Saturday, we're thrilled to host The Brew Notes, a local acoustic folk rock trio known for their soulful harmonies and engaging stage presence.

About The Brew Notes

The Brew Notes have been captivating audiences throughout the region with their unique blend of folk, rock, and indie sounds. Featuring acoustic guitar, violin, and rich vocal harmonies, they create an intimate musical experience that pairs perfectly with our craft beer atmosphere.

Event Details

  • Performance Time: 8:00 PM - 11:00 PM
  • Genre: Acoustic Folk Rock
  • Seating: First come, first served
  • Cover: No cover charge
  • Age: 21+ after 9:00 PM, all ages welcome before

What to Expect

  • Original compositions and creative covers of popular songs
  • Interactive performance - feel free to make requests!
  • Full bar service featuring our rotating tap selection
  • Food menu available throughout the performance
  • Relaxed atmosphere perfect for date nights or hanging with friends

Food & Drink Specials

During live music events, we offer:

  • Happy hour prices on select beers until 9:00 PM
  • Live music food pairing menu
  • Specialty cocktails inspired by the performing artists

Getting Here

We recommend arriving early to secure good seating. Our taproom fills up quickly during live music events! Parking is available in our lot and on nearby streets.

Support local music and local beer - we'll see you Saturday night!

name: Trivia Thursdays
brief_description: Test your knowledge and win prizes at our weekly trivia night!
content:
Trivia Thursdays at Broken Loop Brewing

Join us every Thursday night for an exciting trivia challenge that will test your knowledge across a variety of topics! Whether you're a trivia master or just looking for a fun night out, our weekly trivia nights offer something for everyone.

What to Expect

Our trivia nights feature multiple rounds covering everything from pop culture and sports to history and science. Teams of up to 6 people compete for fantastic prizes, including brewery gift cards, branded merchandise, and even growler fills of our signature beers.

Prizes & Rewards

  • 1st Place: $50 brewery gift card + branded merchandise
  • 2nd Place: $25 brewery gift card
  • 3rd Place: Brewery t-shirts for the team
  • Participation: 10% off food orders for all trivia participants

How It Works

  • Teams can have up to 6 members
  • Registration starts at 6:30 PM
  • Trivia begins promptly at 7:00 PM
  • 5 rounds of questions with varying point values
  • Food and drinks available throughout the event

Come early to grab a table and enjoy our rotating selection of craft beers and delicious food menu. Our trivia host keeps the energy high and the questions challenging but fair.

No reservations required - just show up and have fun!
